visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Give the Operation Its Own Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The switch and its arithmetic sit inside main. Move the decision into a function that returns the result, and make main only print. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Returning straight from each case removes the need for break and the temporary result variable. The calculator logic is now testable on its own and main only handles printing.
